about.title: Built to Make Presenting Feel Natural
paragraphs: SolPrompter is an AI teleprompter created for people who want to speak confidently without memorizing every word or constantly managing scroll controls.

Our goal is to create the most complete and accessible online teleprompter experience, combining reliable AI scrolling, thoughtful design, natural-eye-contact tools and professional recording features.
Whether you are recording from a phone, presenting from a laptop or controlling a studio setup remotely, SolPrompter helps you stay focused on your audience instead of the software.

finalCta.title: Start Using SolPrompter
finalCta.description: Add your script, choose your preferred reading mode and start presenting naturally.
finalCta.supporting: No ads. No watermark. No complicated setup.

items.a: SolPrompter is currently free to use. You can access its essential teleprompter, script and recording features without advertisements or a branded video watermark.
AI Voice Scroll listens to your speech and moves through the script based on your natural speaking pace. It helps you pause, continue and present without constantly adjusting a fixed scroll speed.

Notch Mode places a compact teleprompter reading area close to your camera. This helps reduce visible eye movement and makes your eye contact appear more natural during recordings, presentations and video calls.

items.q: Can I use SolPrompter on a phone or tablet?
items.a: Yes. SolPrompter has a responsive interface designed for smartphones, tablets, laptops and desktop computers. Available features may depend on the browser, camera and device capabilities.

items.q: Do I need to install SolPrompter?
items.a: No installation is required for the web version. You can open SolPrompter in a supported modern browser, add your script and start presenting online.

items.q: Can I control SolPrompter from another device?
items.a: Yes. SolPrompter remote control lets you use another phone, tablet or computer to start or pause the teleprompter, adjust scrolling and navigate through your script.
SolPrompter supports Full HD and 4K recording when the camera, browser and device support the selected resolution. Actual recording quality depends on the capabilities and permissions of your device.

items.q: Does SolPrompter add a watermark to recordings?
items.a: SolPrompter does not add a branded watermark to your recorded videos.

items.q: Which script file formats does SolPrompter support?
items.a: SolPrompter supports pasting text directly and uploading supported script documents such as TXT, DOCX, PDF and Markdown files.

items.q: Can SolPrompter be used as an online autocue?
items.a: Yes. SolPrompter can be used as a browser-based online autocue with manual scrolling, fixed-speed automatic scrolling and AI voice-activated scrolling.
